short_description: Panel-relative research-style PGS signal for smoking ever/never status.
summary_note: This score estimates a cautious, reference-panel-relative genetic signal for smoking ever/never status.
what_it_measures: A polygenic score associated with Smoking status (ever vs never smokers) in PGS Catalog. It does not report this user's real-world habits or choices.
interpretation_template: Smoking ever/never tendency is presented as a cautious genetic signal, not a statement about current or past behavior and not lifestyle advice. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. This is not a statement about the user?s actual habits, choices, dependence, health, or behavior, and it is not medical or lifestyle advice.
limitations: The score does not determine or prove current or past real-world behavior.
Lifestyle traits are strongly shaped by environment, culture, personal choice, and measurement context.
Reference distribution is built from local raw files and may be small or ancestry-biased.
No genotype imputation is used, so missing variants can affect the estimate.
confidence_note: Confidence depends on raw-file coverage and overlap with scoring variants; it is not clinical or behavioral certainty.
reference_note: Reference panel: local empirical panel from available Autosomal raw files, excluding bot staging folders.
